operations.name: Dropship Orders
operations.description: Reads the calling supplier's dropship purchase orders, cursor-paginated with first/after forward and last/before backward.

scenarios.name: Query all dropship orders
scenarios.description: Reads the supplier's orders oldest first, 100 per page, following pageInfo.endCursor until hasNextPage is false. Every filter is listed and left null so the whole order set is read. The response is the forward page first asks for; last and before are declared for the backward walk and left unset.

request.name: Query

scenarios.name: Filter dropship orders by status, line item status, task and date
scenarios.description: All four filters in one request. The sandbox pairs the one order satisfying every filter with three decoys each failing exactly one, so a filter left off shows up as an extra order. A createdAt interval needs both bounds, must start within the last 180 days and cannot be wider than 30 days. Sending orderStatus alone, or createdAt alone, are the optional status and date-range certification steps.

request.name: Query

scenarios.name: Invalid filter in request
scenarios.description: A request the contract refuses. The error carries the Master Error Catalog code, whether it is worth retrying, what to do about it, and the request id to quote in support - branch on extensions.code, never on the message. STAGED describes an order rather than a line item, so filtering line items on it is refused with BAD_USER_INPUT (HTTP 400) instead of being answered with an empty page.

request.name: Query

errors.message: The lineItemStatus filter does not support STAGED: no line item is published in that status.

extensions.remediation: Please filter line items on one of NEW, PROCESSING, READY_FOR_PICKUP, PICKED_UP_AWAITING_CARRIER_SCAN, IN_TRANSIT_CARRIER_SCAN_RECEIVED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, RETURNED, or filter on orderStatus instead.

scenarios.name: Read buyer details (PII permission required)
scenarios.description: The same read selecting the identifying fields of every address - name, address1, address2, address3, postalCode, phoneNumber and email on customer, shippingAddress, billingAddress and the warehouse address. Those fields are gated by orders:read-dropship-orders-pii. Without it the request is not refused: the order is served, the gated fields read null, city, state and country are served as usual, and one FORBIDDEN_SCOPE error lists the redacted paths in extensions.fields - this is the response shown here, and the response the optional PII certification step grades. With the permission granted the same request returns every field populated and no error.

request.name: Query

errors.message: Not authorized to read name, address1, address2, address3, postalCode, phoneNumber, email: orders:read-dropship-orders-pii is not granted to this application. Every other field you asked for was served, and each address carries city, state and country.

extensions.remediation: On the sandbox, certify against orders:read-dropship-orders-pii, then have it granted to your application and re-mint the token.

Paging runs both ways - `first`/`after` reads forward, `last`/`before` reads backward from the end of the result set - but only one direction per request.
